name: bento-grid
idea: irregular grid of mixed-size blocks; rhythm from size variety
heading: display head above the first row; grid starts inside the first screen
body: six to nine blocks, spans 1x1 2x1 1x2 2x2, image tracks minmax(0,1fr)
button: outlined chip in the hero; typographic verb link inside a tile
image: tight crops inside blocks, never full-bleed
reveal: none or one fade as the grid enters
reach_for: many small things to show: feature pages, SaaS landings
avoid_for: a single hero idea; figure or quote blocks need user-supplied facts

name: long-document
idea: memo, letter or journal entry in continuous prose with inline heads
heading: inline run-in heads in bold, part of the paragraph flow
body: single column, leading 1.65+, 60-65ch
divider: white space; at most one ornament
button: verb link inside a paragraph, the fold's one action
image: inline at measure width
reveal: none
reach_for: case studies, founder posts, mission pages, philosophical sales
avoid_for: pages with one decisive transactional action

name: marquee-hero
idea: the hero is the whole first screen; below it the page turns into something else
heading: display statement filling the fold at clamp(4rem,10vw,9rem)
body: one content block or a list of work under the fold
divider: thick rule or hard paper change
button: one small action under the statement
image: none, or one full-bleed photo as background
reveal: static fold; below-fold may sweep sideways
reach_for: portfolios, one-voice indie products, who-we-are pages
avoid_for: products whose value needs explaining in seconds
built_from: poster or corridor hero, then rows, grid or showcase

name: stat-led
idea: a user-supplied figure plus the line that says what it means
heading: giant tabular figure paired with a worded headline
body: sections each anchored by a figure or chart
button: outlined chip with a verb under the qualifier
image: charts only; product photos in requested slots
reveal: number tick on the hero figure, final value in markup
reach_for: proof in numbers: enterprise, fundraising, impact
avoid_for: no user figure; a bare figure fails gate 46b

name: workbench
idea: real captures as the content; a guided tour with short captions
heading: plain functional head at section size
body: figure blocks, each with a factual caption and one annotation
button: hero action, optionally a sticky bottom bar after the third capture
image: real unframed captures; a built product in a slot until supplied
reveal: one type unmask on the first caption
reach_for: SaaS, developer tools, extensions
avoid_for: conceptual or service-led products

name: conversational-faq
idea: honest interview: bold questions with direct answers
heading: each section head is a question
body: short answer under each question; may be disclosures
divider: hairline between pairs or paper change
button: verb link in an answer; one outlined call at the foot
image: sparse; one diagram per long answer
reveal: none on load; disclosure opens on grid-template-rows
reach_for: near pricing, sceptical buyers, regulated or educational fields
avoid_for: pages with no open questions; use another shape to open the page

name: manifesto
idea: polemical large type: what to believe before what to buy
heading: uppercase display, optionally tilted 2-4 degrees, one weight and colour
body: short single-assertion paragraphs set large
divider: changes of paper or theme rules, never cards
button: one solid accent block, repeated at the foot
image: none for ideas; photographs of the cause if physical
reveal: one horizontal sweep on the first claim
reach_for: repositioning, mission-led products, belief pages
avoid_for: checkout, pricing, product tours

name: photographic
idea: huge photographs lead; text is small annotation
heading: small head and one sentence on a plate at the image base
body: full-bleed bands alternating with sections carried by the theme's own material; photos up to about 45% of the page
button: verb link on the plate
image: full-bleed, from the user; library photos in slots until then
reveal: no spatial motion
reach_for: fashion, hospitality, photography, lifestyle
avoid_for: subjects with nothing to photograph

name: quote-led
idea: hero is a supplied quote with its attribution
heading: italic display of the quote at the small display size, whole head italic
body: further supplied quotes, case studies or a modest feature list
divider: centred quote glyph or short rule
button: verb link under the attribution
image: the real person's photo or the company mark, or nothing
reveal: none in the fold; stagger below
reach_for: B2B with strong customer voices, case-study pages
avoid_for: no supplied quote (never write or paraphrase one)

name: specimen
idea: large serif display, asymmetric spans, hairlines, typographic call, whitespace
heading: a large serif phrase standing alone; generated ordinals via counters
body: narrow marginalia column beside a wide content column
button: typographic verb link, no box or arrow
image: none, or one photo of the face in print
reveal: fade-up stagger on first load
reach_for: type, publishing, writing: foundry, journal, press
avoid_for: product pages needing a demo; editorial genre alone does not qualify

name: catalogue
idea: uniform grid of variants of one thing: faces, palettes, SKUs
heading: one line of display over the grid, products lead
body: 3-5 equal cards per row, each one variant
button: a link in each card to its detail; no global call
image: swatch or thumbnail per card, or cards set in type; never empty frames
reveal: none
reach_for: foundries, palette tools, font shops, capsule collections
avoid_for: narrative brands or products with hierarchy

name: letter
idea: first-person personal note opening with a greeting
heading: the salutation in display italic at 1.5-2x body
body: single narrow column, about 50ch, as if typed
button: no button; the sign-off link carries a verb
image: a signature scan, quiet inline photo or nothing
reveal: none
reach_for: personal brands, founder announcements, donation appeals
avoid_for: transactional commerce

name: index-first
idea: navigation as design: the page itself is a list of links
heading: short head naming the index plus one line
body: vertical categorised list with a filter row or disclosure
button: the links are the buttons
image: none, or one photo of the collection
reveal: none
reach_for: documentation hubs, archives, link pages with substance
avoid_for: hard-sell pages

name: narrative-workflow
idea: the story of use over time told in numbered stages
heading: stage number inside the heading or from ol counters, never a separate label
body: a short explanation per stage plus one object shown at full size, varied from stage to stage
button: hero action, returning once at the foot
image: a real capture per stage, or figures and rows
reveal: one horizontal sweep on the first stage
reach_for: products with explicit workflows
avoid_for: tools that work in one moment

name: split-studio
idea: diptych: text one side, proof the other, proof keeps its side
heading: half the screen wide, proof on the other half
body: rows vary by weight not side; one lead row gives proof more share
button: outlined chip under the text half
image: proof side of every row: a capture or built product in a slot
reveal: hero halves fade in 60-100ms apart
reach_for: SaaS feature pages, developer tools pairing words with code
avoid_for: narrative or photographic brands

name: feature-stack
idea: sticky heading pane with a scroll-synced pane of captures
heading: held in the sticky pane
body: two columns, left sticky, right cycles 3-6 captures
divider: section bands; pane re-anchors per section
button: in the pane, shown at the last capture; visible with scripting off
image: real captures or built slots
reveal: the sticky scroll is the motion
reach_for: premium products, complex feature stories
avoid_for: mobile-first audiences without a fallback; under 60rem the pane stacks

name: type-specimen
idea: the design is the typeface itself
heading: the face set at several sizes
body: progressive demonstration: display, body, italic, language coverage, features
button: one outlined action, repeated at the foot
image: none; type is the imagery
reveal: one type unmask on the first specimen
reach_for: type foundries, font product pages
avoid_for: brands using an off-the-shelf face

name: portfolio-grid
idea: filterable cards of projects where the work is the product
heading: short line above the grid, no display
body: responsive grid of project cards of near-equal size
divider: the filter row above the grid
button: link inside each card; no global call
image: a thumbnail per card; until supplied, set in type with at most one slot
reveal: card fade on filter change
reach_for: studios, agencies, photographer portfolios
avoid_for: products

name: map-diagram
idea: one large spatial diagram organises the page
heading: orientation head at section size above or beside the map
body: nodes and edges with a legend
button: links inside nodes; the page action beside the orientation phrase in the fold
image: SVG of the real system or places, labelled or hidden with a text legend
reveal: node-by-node draw-on, up to five nodes, once
reach_for: system overviews, ecosystem and org maps
avoid_for: stories that should not be read spatially; under 60rem scroll sideways or become an ordered list

name: ecosystem-index
idea: several ways in: featured, latest, by category, by people
heading: one positioning line, no display
body: several rails or grids each cutting the content differently
divider: each rail has its own h2; hairline or paper change
button: verb link at each rail's edge
image: thumbnails throughout, the platform's real content
reveal: none
reach_for: community platforms, marketplaces, asset stores
avoid_for: single-product pages

name: component-playground
idea: the content is interactive blocks of code and preview
heading: each category a real h2 in sentence case
body: block after block, each a preview followed by its code, with optional framework tabs
divider: paper change per category; hairlines between examples
button: a Copy button per code block that swaps label, no toast
image: previews are the imagery
reveal: none
reach_for: design systems, component libraries, snippet sites, docs
avoid_for: marketing pages; mono only inside code blocks
